texts.Name: Anton Dziatkovskii
texts.Why do you want to join us?: I am a security engineer who runs what he defends: a production multi-machine Claude agent fleet (6 machines, 100+ automation routines), operated in public, with guardrails I build myself - agent-leash, verbatim-citation-gate (MIT, catches fabricated RAG citations), three-circuit homeostatic governance (preprint). Resend sits at the intersection I care about: a developer-first platform with a genuinely adversarial abuse surface - email is where fraud lives. My background is a decade in adversarial crypto markets (exchange backends, market-maker engines, smart-contract audits) plus an MSc in Computer & Information Systems Security (MEPhI, cryptography). I am based in Lisbon, Portugal - EU citizen, fully in European time.
texts.Tell us about how you uniquely raise the: Three ways. 1) I build deterministic, zero-token gates instead of policy documents: verbatim-citation-gate catches fabricated citations with a burden-of-proof judge; agent-leash constrains what production agents may do. In recorded evals of my agent fleet, 0/17 high-risk (Tier-2) actions slipped past the human approval gate - and the failure modes are documented in public (FAILURE-MODES.md). 2) I bring anti-fraud instincts from adversarial crypto markets - smart-contract audit background, exchange infrastructure, market-maker engines - environments where an attacker is always live. 3) I make security legible to the whole organization: I publish the evals and write the operating manual day by day, so the bar rises for everyone, not just for the security team.
